content:
[directory_health]
version = 1
status = "active"
phase = "repository-best-in-class-phase-6.2"
owner = "team-quality"
mode = "fail_closed"
directory_contracts_source = "architecture/policies/directory_contracts.toml"
test_ratchets_source = "architecture/tests/ratchets.toml"
asset_placement_source = "architecture/asset_placement.toml"
generated_artifacts_source = "architecture/generated_artifacts.toml"
validator_command = "uv run polisyos-tools validation directory-health --fail-on-regression"
dashboard_command = "uv run polisyos-tools validation directory-health --format markdown"
top_level_path_moves_active = false
top_level_fail_closed_policy = "active: all top-level directory and loose-file regressions require explicit dated exceptions."
regression_policy = "Directory health metrics may not move in the wrong direction unless architecture/policies/directory_health.toml records a time-bounded health_exception."

[thresholds]
high_volume_tracked_files = 20
high_volume_child_directories = 10
feature_module_file_threshold = 25
dashboard_largest_subtree_limit = 10
frontend_subtree_doc_roots = [
  "apps",
  "packages",
  "frontend",
]
source_residue_roots = [
  "src",
  "docs",
  "schemas",
  "tests",
]
allowed_non_product_init_roots = [
  "benchmarks",
  "examples",
  "tests",
  "tools",
]
allowed_root_loose_files = [
  ".editorconfig",
  ".env.example",
  ".gitignore",
  ".markdownlint-cli2.jsonc",
  ".nvmrc",
  ".pre-commit-config.yaml",
  ".python-version",
  ".taplo.toml",
  ".yamllint",
  "CHANGELOG-DESIGN.md",
  "CHANGELOG.md",
  "CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md",
  "CONTRIBUTING.md",
  "Dockerfile.reproducible",
  "LICENSE",
  "README.md",
  "SECURITY.md",
  "SUPPORT.md",
  "basedpyright.toml",
  "install.sh",
  "jax_bootstrap.py",
  "migrate.py",
  "mkdocs.yml",
  "mutmut.cfg",
  "mypy.ini",
  "package.json",
  "pnpm-lock.yaml",
  "pnpm-workspace.yaml",
  "pyproject.toml",
  "hatch.toml",
  "pytest.ini",
  "ruff.toml",
  "uv.lock",
  "uv.toml",
]
data_only_roots = [
  "data",
  "tests/_data",
  "tests/_golden",
  "benchmarks/_data",
]
data_only_directory_names = [
  "__fixtures__",
  "_data",
  "_golden",
  "assets",
  "fixtures",
]
registered_frontend_fixture_roots = [
  "apps/runtime-dashboard/src/test/contracts/fixtures",
  "apps/runtime-dashboard/src/test/fixtures",
  "apps/runtime-dashboard/src/features/trust/components/__fixtures__",
]
ignored_empty_directory_roots = [
  ".git",
  ".hypothesis",
  ".mypy_cache",
  ".pytest_cache",
  ".ruff_cache",
  ".venv",
  "_build",
  "_cache",
  "node_modules",
  "apps/runtime-dashboard/node_modules",
]
feature_owner_file_names = [
  "README.md",
  "AUTHORING.md",
  "OWNER",
  "OWNERS",
  "owner.toml",
]

[[gate]]
id = "mirror-ratio"
area = "tests"
owner = "team-quality"
mode = "fail_closed_no_regression"
command = "uv run python tools/quality/testing/report_test_ratchets.py --fail-on-regression"
evidence = "architecture/tests/ratchets.toml"

[[gate]]
id = "no-regression"
area = "tests"
owner = "team-quality"
mode = "fail_closed_no_regression"
command = "uv run python tools/quality/testing/report_test_ratchets.py --fail-on-regression"
evidence = "architecture/tests/ratchets.toml"

[[gate]]
id = "property-test"
area = "tests"
owner = "team-quality"
mode = "fail_closed_no_regression"
command = "uv run python tools/quality/testing/report_test_ratchets.py --fail-on-regression"
evidence = "architecture/tests/ratchets.toml"

[[gate]]
id = "fixture-golden"
area = "tests"
owner = "team-quality"
mode = "fail_closed_contract"
command = "uv run pytest tests/repo_quality/architecture/test_test_ratchets_contract.py -q"
evidence = "architecture/tests/ratchets.toml"

[[gate]]
id = "repo-quality"
area = "tests"
owner = "team-quality"
mode = "fail_closed_contract"
command = "uv run pytest tests/repo_quality/architecture/test_test_topology_contract.py -q"
evidence = "architecture/tests/topology.toml"

[[gate]]
id = "pytest-root"
area = "tests"
owner = "team-quality"
mode = "fail_closed_contract"
command = "uv run pytest tests/repo_quality/architecture/test_test_ratchets_contract.py -q"
evidence = "architecture/tests/ratchets.toml"

[[gate]]
id = "benchmark-role"
area = "benchmarks"
owner = "team-quality"
mode = "fail_closed_contract"
command = "uv run pytest tests/repo_quality/architecture/test_test_ratchets_contract.py -q"
evidence = "architecture/tests/ratchets.toml"

[[gate]]
id = "top-level-directory-contract"
area = "directory_closure"
owner = "team-architecture"
mode = "fail_closed"
command = "uv run polisyos-tools validation directory-health --fail-on-regression"
evidence = "architecture/policies/directory_contracts.toml"

[[gate]]
id = "top-level-loose-file-allow-list"
area = "directory_closure"
owner = "team-architecture"
mode = "fail_closed"
command = "uv run polisyos-tools validation directory-health --fail-on-regression"
evidence = "architecture/policies/directory_health.toml"

[[gate]]
id = "forbidden-lifecycle-commits"
area = "directory_closure"
owner = "team-architecture"
mode = "fail_closed"
command = "uv run polisyos-tools validation directory-health --fail-on-regression"
evidence = "architecture/policies/directory_contracts.toml"

[[gate]]
id = "source-local-residue"
area = "directory_closure"
owner = "team-devx"
mode = "ratchet_from_current_count"
command = "uv run polisyos-tools validation directory-health --fail-on-regression"
evidence = "architecture/asset_placement.toml"

[[gate]]
id = "phase-local-junk-residue"
area = "directory_closure"

mode = "fail_closed"

evidence = "architecture/policies/directory_health.toml"

[[gate]]
id = "non-product-init-files"
area = "directory_closure"
owner = "team-architecture"
mode = "fail_closed"
command = "uv run polisyos-tools validation directory-health --fail-on-regression"
evidence = "architecture/policies/directory_contracts.toml"

[[gate]]
id = "product-imports-tests-benchmarks"
area = "directory_closure"
owner = "team-architecture"
mode = "fail_closed"
command = "uv run polisyos-tools validation directory-health --fail-on-regression"

[[gate]]
id = "data-only-pytest-collectable"
area = "directory_closure"

[[gate]]

[[gate]]
id = "generated-api-placement"
area = "directory_closure"
owner = "team-frontend"

[[gate]]
id = "empty-ui-component-directory"
area = "directory_closure"
owner = "team-frontend"
mode = "fail_closed"
command = "uv run polisyos-tools validation directory-health --fail-on-regression"
evidence = "architecture/frontend_workspaces.toml"

[[gate]]
id = "feature-module-owner-threshold"
area = "directory_closure"
owner = "team-frontend"
mode = "fail_closed"
command = "uv run polisyos-tools validation directory-health --fail-on-regression"
evidence = "docs/reference/frontend/workspace-contract.md"

[[metric_baseline]]
id = "top_level_directory_contract_coverage_percent"
direction = "not_decrease"
value = 100.0
owner = "team-architecture"
